key_findings.finding: v4 Compose uses pg17; v5 uses pg18. Preserve the installed PostgreSQL major and volume rather than copying the fresh-install default.
5.1 adds the separate Compose app migration service; v5.4 app startup does not wait for it. Explicit app/Hub sequencing is required.
5.4 generic OIDC removes unconditional response iss requirement; OIDC_EMAIL_CLAIM is not a supported override.
Hub worker is absent in v5/v6.0 Compose and present in 6.1; Helm already includes it.
Envoy 1.8.4 starts at 5.4.3, not all of 5.4. Cube 5.4.5 and 6.0.2 initially ship 1.7.47-1, not -2.
Released 6.0 includes the maintenance preparation executable. Do not require operators to locate an unnamed tested pair.
Workspace/environment conversion, storage URL conversion, typed-attribute backfill, Better Auth account identity and large response indexes need checks on existing data.

method: Compare adjacent stable tags and inspect first-minor/latest-patch assets. Cross-minor comparisons include branch/backport divergence; review actual target files for claims.
runtime_evidence: No full application upgrade or restore rehearsal performed. Published 6.0.2 -> 6.1.0 evidence retained as reported evidence only. Recommended catch-up stops are source-reviewed rehearsal routes.
scope: All stable 4.x, 5.x and 6.x tags available at review time; operator-facing deployment assets, application schema/data migrations, environment and SSO configuration. Earlier guides retained without re-review. This is not an exhaustive product/API audit.
